title: CRISPR gene drive suppression of Anopheles gambiae populations in large indoor cages
items.abstract: We demonstrate a CRISPR-based gene drive that spreads a female-sterility allele through caged Anopheles gambiae populations, collapsing them within 8 generations. The system is a candidate tool for malaria vector control.

title: CRISPR-Cas9 editing of antimalarial resistance loci in Plasmodium falciparum
items.abstract: A CRISPR-Cas9 protocol for editing kelch13 and crt resistance loci in Plasmodium falciparum, the malaria parasite, with implications for drug resistance surveillance rather than vector control.

title: Soil microbiome responses to drought in alpine grasslands
items.abstract: Amplicon sequencing of alpine grassland soils before and after experimental drought reveals shifts in Actinobacteria abundance and overall metabolic potential.

title: CRISPR gene drive suppression of Anopheles gambiae populations in large indoor cages (author preprint)
items.abstract: Preprint of the caged-population CRISPR gene drive study later published in the Journal of Synthetic Vector Biology; same DOI minted for the version of record.
